question: What happens when all beings are understood to enter that blazing awareness?
premises: A fire blazes with hundreds of front flames spreading from all the masses of senses.
All beings may be considered to enter there.
This entry is presented as a matter of reflective understanding.
inference: Therefore, if the entry of all beings into that blazing awareness is reflectively understood, that very locus is the site of universal absorption.
plain_english: If one reflectively understands that all beings enter into that which blazes with hundreds of foremost flames spreading forth from all the streams of the senses, then that very place is where their entry occurs.
